terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

displayContent.description: Text displayed in place of delta. Omit it to display the original.

title: MessageDisplay hook output
description: Replaces what is shown on screen. Display only: the transcript and what Claude sees keep the original. If the hook fails or times out the original text is displayed. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
